messages:
Amy L: Heads-up: planning joint marketplace bundle with VaultX next quarter. Need SSO/SAML, SCIM, and KMS connector sign-off. Who can lead integration work? :wave:
Jordan P: I can own SAML/SCIM tests. What's timeline?
Amy L: Target public listing: 2026-07-15. So engineering milestones: config complete by 2026-06-20, integration testing by 06-30, pre-announce the week of 07-06. Need legal/compliance review by 06-10.
Sahil R: I'll take KMS/HSM integration + secrets manager connector. Questions: are we going to support VaultX's HSM key proxy or run pass-through to customer's KMS?
Marie K: From GTM side, we want 'bring your own KMS' + managed VaultX connector. Need to confirm supported algorithms (RSA/PSS, AES-GCM) and key rotation policy.
Jordan P: @Sahil R can you pair with @DevSecOps Bot for encryption key rotation checklist? Also need SCIM group mapping spec.
DevSecOps Bot: Automated checklist created: /ops/checklists/marketplace-sso-integration. Steps: metadata exchange, assertion validation, SCIM provisioning sample, KMS key policy doc.
Amy L: Link to draft partner playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partners/vaultx-marketplace-bundle (internal). Please add integration notes under 'Tech Notes' section.
Sahil R: Quick SCIM sample we used for Acme: ```{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"jdoe","name":{"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Doe"}}``` will reuse and add group mapping.
Jordan P: SAML metadata snippet we need from VaultX: entityID, x509 cert, ACS URL. We'll validate signatures with our cert chain. Also add test harness: `tests/integration/saml_vaultx_test.py`.
Marie K: Marketing note: joint announcement embargo until both compliance and listing approvals cleared. Draft comms by 06-25. @Amy L please own the embargo calendar.
Amy L: On it. I'll loop in legal (Carla D) and compliance (Raj M). @Carla D @Raj M can you confirm timelines?
Carla D: We need vendor risk assessment (VRM) completed. I expect 5 business days after we get their security questionnaire. Send me the questionnaire by 06-03.
Raj M: Pinged VaultX for security questionnaire and HSM attestation. Also ask for SOC2 and KMS audit logs retention policy.
Jordan P: :thumbsup: Will draft the integration test plan and post it to the Confluence page by EOD tomorrow.
Sahil R: One more: secrets rotation — we must support zero-downtime key rollover. Design doc snippet: `rollingKeyExchange(v1 -> v2): dual-encrypt, switch pointers, deprecate v1 after grace period`.
Amy L: Action items summary (very short):
- Jordan: SAML/SCIM tests + test harness
- Sahil: KMS/HSM + secrets connector
- Marie: GTM comms + embargo
- Carla/Raj: compliance & VRM
- Amy: coordinate timelines & partner contact
Please add tasks to the partnership board.
Jordan P: Added Jira epic PART-5123 and linked Confluence. @everyone react with :white_check_mark: when you add your tasks.
Marie K: :white_check_mark:
Sahil R: :white_check_mark:
Carla D: :white_check_mark:
DevSecOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: /remind #partnerships 'VaultX integration checkpoint' on 2026-06-15 10:00AM
